polity.canonical_name_en: Guangzhou Government of the Republic of China

activity.notes: The Guangzhou extraordinary parliament elected Sun president in April 1921 and he was sworn in on 5 May. Chen Jiongming's revolt forced Sun from the presidential office in June 1922, ending this southern-government presidency.

sources.title: Chronology of Dr. Sun Yat-sen — National Dr. Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall
sources.citation_text: Official chronology records Sun's 1912 provisional presidency, 1917-1918 grand-marshal leadership of the Constitutional Protection government, 1921-1922 Guangzhou presidency, and restoration as grand marshal in 1923.
